name: ESP][ mechanical coordinate system
notes: All later enclosure CAD must use this convention.

Y.positive: toward the rear I/O wall (away from the user)

origin.description: Intersection of bottom-plate top face and the vertical mid-plane of the beige upper, at the front-most keyboard bezel reference plane
origin.notes: Exact numeric origin lock waits for miniature scale freeze; axis directions are FIXED.

boardOrientation.description: Waveshare module stands vertically inside the monitor housing
boardOrientation.moduleLongAxis: +Z (USB-C end toward enclosure bottom / lower monitor)

insertionDirection.description: Board inserted from below into upper enclosure, guided to positive stop, then retained by screws
